query: How does the Board treat the maturity proceeds by the insurer after I reached 55 years old?
reference_answer: The maturity proceeds from your insurance policies under the CPF Investment Scheme-Ordinary Account (CPFIS-OA) and the CPF Investment Scheme-Special Account (CPFIS-SA) are handled differently.For insurance policies under:CPFIS-OAFor CPFIS-OA policies, the proceeds would be refunded to your CPF Investment Account with your agent bank. You can instruct your bank to transfer the monies back to your CPF Ordinary Account. You can apply for withdrawal of the monies (once the proceeds are credited) subject to the prevailing CPF withdrawal rules. Find out more onwithdrawal of CPF savings.For policies that have already been transferred to your name earlier when you applied for withdrawal of your CPFIS investments, it would be considered as cash policies and the insurance companies would pay the proceeds directly to you.If you need to withdraw more than the default online Daily Withdrawal Limit of $2,000, find outmore.If you need to withdraw more than the maximum online Daily Withdrawal Limit, find outmore.CPFIS-SAFor CPFIS-SA policies, the proceeds would be refunded to your CPF Special Account. You can apply for withdrawal of the monies (once the proceeds are credited) subject to the prevailing CPF withdrawal rules. Find out more onwithdrawal of CPF savings.If you need to withdraw more than the default online Daily Withdrawal Limit of $2,000, find outmore.If you need to withdraw more than the maximum online Daily Withdrawal Limit, find outmore.For policies that have already been transferred to your name when you applied for withdrawal of your CPFIS investments, it would be considered as cash policies and the insurance companies would pay the proceeds directly to you.

answer: After reaching 55 years old, the maturity proceeds from your insurance policies under CPFIS-OA are refunded to your CPF Investment Account with your agent bank. You can then transfer these funds back to your CPF Ordinary Account or withdraw them according to CPF withdrawal rules. For CPFIS-SA policies, the proceeds are directly paid to you by the insurance company. [Document 1]
